name: Invoke
description:
It is possible to invoke an object, that means calling a function built with the object as the function name. 

Invocation is based on the ``__invoke`` magic method.

Being invokable, or invocable, means that an object may be used as a function name.
code:
<?php

class elephpant {
    function __invoke($a) {
        echo 'I am '.$a;
    }
}

$elephpant = new elephpant;
$elephpant('elephpant'); // I am elephpant

?>
